subject: MAP entry checks & evidence onramp — Cedar Analytics POC (SOC 2 / SIG / DPA)
messages:
From: Claire Hammond <claire.h@cedaranalytics.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Moroz <alex.m@cedaranalytics.com>, procurement@cedaranalytics.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & Evidence: Cedar Analytics POC - SOC 2 / SIG / DPA scope

Hi Olga —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Our security and procurement teams want to align on a brief mutual action plan (MAP) and the minimum evidence we need to accept a short pilot. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm SOC 2 Type II attestation availability and most recent report date.
- SIG/CAIQ responses for hosted/shared vs private deployment (we may start hosted, but need clarity).
- DPA / data residency language — we need EU data residency for test datasets used in the POC, and a 90-day retention window for logs unless otherwise agreed.
- A short milestones timeline (entry criteria, evidence handoff, go/no-go by week 3).

Can you share a MAP draft and point us to the evidence artifacts? Procurement would like to see the DPA redline ahead of legal review.

Goal: sign off on the MAP and kick off an initial 4-week POC (small dataset) by the week of 6/28 if gating items are satisfied.

Appreciate a quick confirmation on next steps and any required DocuSign flow.

Best,
Claire Hammond
Head of Partnerships
Cedar Analytics

Subject: Re: MAP & Evidence: Cedar Analytics POC - SOC 2 / SIG / DPA scope

Hi Claire —

Thanks — this is a great, tight scope. I've attached a first-pass MAP (Cedar_MAP_v1.xlsx) that breaks the POC into entry/evidence/acceptance lanes. Quick answers up front:

- SOC 2: we have a SOC 2 Type II report (March 2027). I'll attach the signed report and a short evidence index in the Drive link below for your security team.
- SIG/CAIQ: we can share our completed CAIQ and note which controls differ between Hosted and Private. Short version: hosted has the same logical controls; the difference is in data residency and customer-managed keys for Private.
- DPA / retention: proposed default retention for POC artifacts is 90 days for request logs; we can scope a tighter 30-day window if you need that for the pilot, subject to a short DPA addendum.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Your security team reviews the MAP + CAIQ items we flagged for Hosted.
2) Karthik will send a DPA redline and a proposed SLA exception for the POC.
3) We align on an evidence handoff date (we propose 6/30) so your team can validate SOC 2 & CAIQ artifacts ahead of the go/no-go on 7/5.

I uploaded the MAP and a Drive folder with SOC 2 artifacts here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0BzCedar/MPA_Cedar_v1

I'll loop in Karthik and Marissa to cover legal and CS milestones.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Director, Enterprise Sales (Security)
Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: MAP & Evidence: Cedar Analytics POC - SOC 2 / SIG / DPA scope

Claire / team —

Thanks — quick legal check and proposed redline posture attached (DPA_Redline_v2.pdf). Summary of the substantive points for the pilot:

- Data residency: we can commit to routing POC processing to EU region (AWS eu-west-1) and to storing transient test datasets in EU-only buckets for the pilot period.
- Retention: we can accept a 90-day default for request/operation logs; if Cedar needs a 30-day window for the pilot, we'll add a POC-specific addendum (no change to general product retention).
- Access controls: we'll include a clause for audit access to support SOC 2 evidence verification during the POC (read-only for your auditors for the 2-week evidence review window).

Outstanding ask from our side: please confirm the exact dataset sizes you'll use and whether any PII/sensitive attributes are present — that determines offboarding steps post-pilot.

If these bullets are OK, Marissa will publish the final MAP timeline and generate a DocuSign envelope for the POC MAP + POC addendum.

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Redwood Inference

Olga / Karthik —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. A few clarifications from Alex (copied):

> On Mon, Jun 26, 2027 at 08:30 AM Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai> wrote:
> > Data residency: we can commit to routing POC processing to EU region (AWS eu-west-1) and to storing transient test datasets in EU-only buckets for the pilot period.

- Confirmed: EU residency for processing + storage is acceptable for the pilot. Please include the exact AWS account IDs or project tags in the MAP so our infra team can validate routing.
- Retention: we will stick with 30 days for request logs during the POC; production retention can follow your standard 90-day policy post-eval.
- SOC 2: we will review the March 2027 report; can you also provide the SOC 2 controls map to your CAIQ responses (so we can map evidence to CAIQ control IDs)?

Last ask: procurement needs the DocuSign for the DPA redline so they can move to internal signature (they cannot accept PDFs as a final DPA).

Thanks — if you can get the MAP with AWS account tags and the DocuSign link into us by end of day 7/1, we can keep the target go/no-go of 7/5.

Best,
Claire
